entities.summary: Bernard Thibault is a French trade unionist who was the secretary of the Confédération Générale du Travail (CGT) between 1999 and 2013, a French workers' union. He represents the moderate wing of the CGT, as opposed to the more radical wing noted in Marseille's trade union.
